stem: In two quarterly RFM runs, a Voltmarkt customer had the same number of orders and the same spend in the 12-month window. Its M score still fell from 4 to 3. What is the most likely reason?

options.text: Other customers spent more, so its rank among them fell
M also counts recency, which grew between the two runs
M is scored with fixed bands, which Voltmarkt moves every quarter
The customer placed a guest order, which lowered its spend
